title: Doors — Fwd Cargo Door Latching — Installation of Self-Lubricating Bushings
abstract: Replacement of the greased bronze bushings in the eight forward cargo door latch pin housings by dry-film self-lubricating items, deleting the 750 flight hour lubrication task on delivered aircraft.

sections.planning_reason: The forward cargo door latching mechanism was generating more than four times its predicted unscheduled removal rate, and teardown of nineteen returned housings found dry running in every case. The greasing task at 750 flight hours is easy to defer on a short turnaround and, in dusty environments, was carrying grit into the bore rather than protecting it. This Service Bulletin brings delivered aircraft to the dry-film bushing standard and deletes the greasing task.
sections.description: The bronze bushings in the eight latch pin housings are pressed out and replaced by dry-film self-lubricating items in a slightly enlarged bore. The inboard splice plate is replaced by a thicker item so that the wall thickness is preserved after boring, the outboard doubler and the aft retention plate are re-drilled, and the harness across the latch beam is re-clipped clear of the enlarged housing bosses. The latch position indication is checked but not modified.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the forward cargo door and set the maintenance stay. Isolate the door actuation system and lock the latch mechanism at the unlocked stop. Do the installation task AMM-M-52-30-13-400-002-A in the reverse sense to remove the eight latch pins. Press out the bronze bushings and bore each housing to the dimension given in the accomplishment instructions. Replace the splice plate D5230131366114 and re-drill the doubler D5230134342244 and the retention plate D5230135480243. Press in the dry-film bushings using the arbor from the tool list. Re-clip the latch beam harness with cable ties EN816709K3 to the routing shown in the accomplishment instructions. Install the eight latch pins and do a rigging check of the latch mechanism. Do the door operational test and a leak check of the door seal, then record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00360 that are still pre MOD-160915. MSN M00202 is excluded because it carries a non-standard latch beam from a repair and needs an individual quotation. Aircraft from MSN M00361 onward are already at the dry-film standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K5230-1024-01 contains the eight bushings, the splice plate, the cable ties and the boring reference gauge. Lead time is ten weeks. Operators are advised to do the borescope survey of Service Bulletin MRD-52-1031 before ordering, because scored pins are not included in the base kit and are ordered separately.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs later.
